title: Endamage
summary: ENDAM'AGE, verb transitive [from damage.] To bring loss or damage to; to harm; to injure; to mischief; to prejudice. The trial hath endamaged thee no way. So thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kin

inlines.v: ENDAM'AGE, verb transitive [from damage.] To bring loss or damage to; to harm; to injure; to mischief; to prejudice. The trial hath endamaged thee no way. So thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings. Ezra 4:13.
